body:
Real, named avrdude profiles for 3 real boards (Uno/new-Nano, old-bootloader Nano, Feather 32u4 -- confirmed via avrdude -c/-p listings, not assumed). New tools/avr_touch_reset.py (real 1200-baud touch reset, verified against a real pty) for the 32u4's Caterina bootloader. Caught and fixed a real bug before shipping: reusing blink_main.c unmodified for the Feather would have toggled the wrong pin (PB5 vs the 32u4's real PC7) at the wrong speed (16MHz vs 8MHz) -- confirmed via avr-objdump disassembly. Fixed the editor's own Upload button: it always flashed the hardcoded blink.prn regardless of the open file -- new AVR_PRN_SOURCE Makefile variable + compile_and_upload_avr now passes the real open file through (shell-quoted, unit-tested). Found and named EDITOR.GAME's own copy of this bug is worse (no avr-* Makefile targets at all). editor-demo-smoke still boots clean, -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror throughout. Commit e42c40a.

⚓ ☃
title: AVR multi-board profiles + Upload-button fix for EDGE.GAME (S584)
